correctness.rationale: Reconstructed inverse branches g±=1/2±u_theta² and transfer weight w=u/(K+theta u); derivative at 1 yields h’(1)=-Ah(1/2), stationarity at 0 yields h(0)=h(1)=0 and h’(0)=ABh(1/2)/(1-B). Integrating the C¹ endpoint expansions gives quadratic local masses. The cited Keller-Liverani small-hole theorem, applied using uniform expansion/BV spectral gap and the vanishing-density BV perturbation bound, gives normalized rate factor 1 at nonperiodic 1 and 1-B at repelling 0; their masses cancel to rate ratio B. Exact independent rational check theta=3/2,7/4,p=2/3 yields A=96,B=9872/33075. This is annealed, fixed-parameter, not quenched/uniform-to-boundary.
